# TimePicker

TimePicker retains native time-entry behavior. External `aria-describedby` IDs merge with helper/error guidance, and an explicit component error remains invalid. The owned field layout follows module direction and exposes a focus indicator for native segments, including engines that do not match them with `:focus-visible`.

- **Import:** `import { TimePicker } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Components
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-timepicker--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, TimePicker } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function TimePickerExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="w-80">
        <TimePicker label="Start time" helperText="Use local time." />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## TimePicker

It forwards its ref to `HTMLInputElement`. Its props are `TimePickerProps`, which extends `Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "type">`.

- `description`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `error`: `boolean | string`, optional.
- `helperText`: `string`, optional.
- `label`: `string`, optional.
- `status`: `InputStatus`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `wrapperClassName`: `string`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the 292 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### InputStatus

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type InputStatus = "default" | "error" | "warning" | "success";
```
